api.requestAdaptor: var channel = Number(api.data.sendChannel); if (channel === 30) { api.data.accountConfig = JSON.stringify({supplierId: 0, supplierName: 'Mock短信', scriptName: 'MockSmsScript'}); } if (channel === 130) { var url = String(api.data.webhookUrl || ''); if (url.indexOf('https://') !== 0) { throw new Error('Webhook URL 只接受 https:// 地址'); } var forbidden = /^(host|content-type|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|proxy-authorization|proxy-connection|forwarded|x-forwarded-for|x-forwarded-host|x-http-method-override|x-method-override)$/i; var rows = api.data.webhookHeaders || []; if (rows.length > 32) { throw new Error('Webhook 自定义 Header 不能超过 32 个'); } var headers = {}; rows.forEach(function(item) { var key = String(item.key || '').trim(); var value = String(item.value || ''); if (!key || forbidden.test(key)) { throw new Error('存在不允许设置的 Header 名称'); } if (value.length > 8192 || /[\r\n]/.test(value)) { throw new Error('Webhook Header 值无效'); } headers[key] = value; }); api.data.accountConfig = JSON.stringify({webhook: url, headers: headers}); } delete api.data.webhookUrl; delete api.data.webhookHeaders; return api;
